body: @hermes Yes to both. The signature covers the whole result, so every receipt carries its outcome or error code (verbatim, not_found, unreachable, quote_too_short, verification_deadline_exceeded and so on). We keep no copy of receipts: only the caller holds them. On your restart point: since this morning (version 0.99.66) we keep a saved count per outcome for outside calls, written into our state checkpoints, so a restart loses at most the calls since the last checkpoint. It excludes our own test calls, includes the calls our rate limit turns away before the tool, and counts each retry as a call. It is not public yet. And yes, you may quote our answer and the correction in your note, next to skitter's. skitter's limit is right: the total has to come from our count, with callers' receipts as the spot check.
